title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,251–1,300 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Bank of Taiwan operates multiple branches in every county.
examples.zh: 臺灣銀行在各縣市均設有多家分行。

examples.en: We sat on the grassy river bank enjoying a peaceful picnic.
examples.zh: 我們坐在青草如茵的河岸邊享受愜意的野餐。

examples.en: Don't bank on good weather for your mountain hike tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天的登山健行可別指望一定會有好天氣。

examples.en: Which local branch did you open your bank account at?
examples.zh: 你是在哪一家分行開立銀行帳戶的？

examples.en: Colorful birds built their nest on a high tree branch.
examples.zh: 色彩鮮豔的小鳥在高高的樹枝上築巢。

examples.en: Physics is a major branch of natural science.
examples.zh: 物理學是自然科學的一個重要分支領域。

examples.en: ATMs are readily accessible inside 7-Eleven and FamilyMart.
examples.zh: 7-Eleven 和全家超商內部都設有極為方便的 ATM。

examples.en: Insert your chip card into the ATM slot and enter your PIN.
examples.zh: 將晶片金融卡插入 ATM 卡槽並輸入個人密碼。

examples.en: The ATM machine was temporarily out of order for routine maintenance.
examples.zh: 這台自動提款機因例行維護暫時停止服務。

examples.en: He deposited ten thousand dollars into his savings account.
examples.zh: 他把一萬元存入了他的儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Tenants must pay a two-month rental deposit before moving in.
examples.zh: 房客在搬進去之前必須先支付兩個月的租金押金。

examples.en: Rich mineral deposits were discovered beneath the mountain ridge.
examples.zh: 山脊底下發現了豐富的礦物沉積礦藏。

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the nearby ATM.
examples.zh: 我需要從附近的提款機領一些現金。

examples.en: The army decided to withdraw troops from the conflict zone.
examples.zh: 軍隊決定從衝突區域撤出部隊兵力。

examples.en: She withdrew her application because of unexpected family matters.
examples.zh: 因為突發的家庭事故，她撤回了求職申請。

examples.en: There is a daily cash withdrawal limit of twenty thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 每日現金提款上限為兩萬元。

examples.en: Heavy alcohol withdrawal symptoms can be dangerous without medical supervision.
examples.zh: 嚴重酒精戒斷症狀若無醫療監督可能十分危險。

examples.en: The military announced the complete withdrawal of all foreign troops.
examples.zh: 軍方宣布所有外國軍隊已全面撤離完畢。

examples.en: It is wise to save part of your monthly salary in a savings account.
examples.zh: 將每月部分薪水存入活期儲蓄帳戶是明智的做法。

examples.en: You need to show your passport and second ID to open a savings account.
examples.zh: 開立活期儲蓄帳戶需要出示護照與第二證件。

examples.en: Online high-yield savings accounts offer much better interest rates.
examples.zh: 線上高利活儲帳戶提供好得多的活儲利率。

examples.en: Check your account balance on the mobile banking app.
examples.zh: 在行動網銀 App 上查詢您的帳戶餘額。

examples.en: Gymnasts need excellent physical coordination and sense of balance.
examples.zh: 體操運動員需要極佳的肢體協調能力與平衡感。

examples.en: Try to maintain a healthy balance between work and family life.
examples.zh: 努力在工作與家庭生活之間保持健康的平衡。

examples.en: The online banking transaction was completed securely.
examples.zh: 該筆線上網銀交易已安全完成。

examples.en: A transaction fee of fifteen dollars applies to international wire transfers.
examples.zh: 跨國電匯轉帳需要收取十五美元的交易手續費。

examples.en: Commercial transactions can now be authenticated using facial recognition.
examples.zh: 商業交易現在已經能夠使用臉部辨識進行身分驗證。

examples.en: You can easily transfer money using mobile phone numbers.
examples.zh: 你可以用手機號碼輕鬆進行跨行轉帳。

examples.en: Passengers can transfer to the airport express train at the central terminal.
examples.zh: 旅客可在中央轉運站轉乘機場快捷列車。

examples.en: The football star was transferred to a Spanish club for a record fee.
examples.zh: 這位足球巨星以創紀錄的轉會費轉隊到了西班牙俱樂部。

examples.en: Overseas migrant workers send remittances back home monthly.
examples.zh: 海外移工每月將薪資匯款寄回老家。

examples.en: Banks provide fast and reliable international remittance services.
examples.zh: 銀行提供迅速且可靠的跨國匯款服務。

examples.en: High transaction fees reduce the real value of small remittances.
examples.zh: 高昂的交易手續費會降低小額匯款的實質價值。

examples.en: Many young adults apply for government student loans for college.
examples.zh: 許多青年申請政府就學貸款以就讀大學。

examples.en: The bank approved their housing mortgage loan with favorable conditions.
examples.zh: 銀行以優惠的條件核准了他們的購屋房貸。

examples.en: Could you loan me twenty dollars until payday tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你能借我二十元到明天發薪日嗎？

examples.en: Fixed-deposit accounts provide steady annual interest earnings.
examples.zh: 定存帳戶能提供穩定的年利息收益。

examples.en: She showed a keen interest in learning conversational Spanish.
examples.zh: 她對學習西班牙語日常會話表現出了濃厚的興趣。

examples.en: It is in your own best interest to consult a legal specialist.
examples.zh: 諮詢法律專業人士最符合你自身的利益。

examples.en: Central banks adjust interest rates to maintain stable economic growth.
examples.zh: 各國央行調整利率以維持穩定的經濟成長。

examples.en: High interest rates make borrowing money for mortgages more expensive.
examples.zh: 高利率使得借貸房貸的成本變得更加沉重。

examples.en: Credit card companies often charge a steep interest rate on unpaid balances.
examples.zh: 信用卡公司通常對未清償餘額收取高昂的循環利率。

examples.en: Try to pay off credit card debts as quickly as possible.
examples.zh: 盡可能快速清償信用卡卡債。

examples.en: The national debt of the country has risen steadily in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近幾十年來該國的國家債務持續攀升。

examples.en: He felt a deep debt of gratitude toward the doctor who saved his life.
examples.zh: 他對拯救他性命的醫生心懷無比深沉的感恩之情。

examples.en: Can I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow afternoon?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的雨傘到明天下午嗎？

examples.en: University students frequently borrow academic textbooks from the library.
examples.zh: 大學生經常向圖書館借閱學術教科書。

examples.en: He had to borrow money from close friends to start his bakery business.
examples.zh: 他不得不向摯友借錢來開設他的烘焙坊。

examples.en: My brother kindly lent me his laptop for my online class.
examples.zh: 我哥哥好心把他的筆電借給我上線上課程。

examples.en: Banks are often reluctant to lend money to unproven startups.
examples.zh: 銀行往往不願意借貸資金給未經證實的新創公司。

examples.en: Could you please lend a hand with moving this heavy sofa?
examples.zh: 你能幫忙伸手搬一下這張沉重的沙發嗎？

examples.en: You paid for lunch, so I owe you one hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 你付了午餐錢，所以我欠你一百元。

examples.en: I owe you a huge favor for taking care of my pets while I was away.
examples.zh: 我不在時你幫忙照看我的寵物，我欠你一個天大人情。

examples.en: The athlete owes his Olympic gold medal to years of rigorous training.
examples.zh: 這位運動員將他的奧運金牌歸功於多年嚴格的艱苦訓練。

examples.en: Don't worry, I will pay you back tomorrow at school.
examples.zh: 別擔心，我明天在學校就會把錢還你。

examples.en: It took him five years of hard work to pay back his university loans.
examples.zh: 他花了五年的努力工作才清償了大學助學貸款。

examples.en: She promised to pay back every single cent she borrowed from her uncle.
examples.zh: 她承諾會把向叔叔借的每一分錢都如數償還。

examples.en: Plan a monthly travel budget before heading to Japan.
examples.zh: 出發去日本前先規劃每月的旅遊預算。

examples.en: We managed to decorate the living room on a very tight budget.
examples.zh: 我們在非常有限緊湊的預算內完成了客廳的裝潢。

examples.en: The government allocated a substantial budget for public transportation.
examples.zh: 政府編列了大筆預算用於大眾交通建設。

examples.en: Higher education often leads to higher average annual income.
examples.zh: 高等教育通常能帶來較高的年均所得。

examples.en: Freelancers must file taxes accurately on all freelance income.
examples.zh: 自由接案者必須就所有接案收入確實誠實申報稅額。

examples.en: Many retirees rely on pension income and investment dividends.
examples.zh: 許多退休人士仰賴退休金收入與投資股利維生。

examples.en: Track your daily living expenses with a budgeting app.
examples.zh: 使用記帳 App 追蹤你的日常生活開銷。

examples.en: Travel and accommodation were the biggest expenses of our vacation.
examples.zh: 交通與住宿是我們這次假期中最主要的支出開銷。

examples.en: He spared no expense to provide the best medical care for his mother.
examples.zh: 他不惜一切代價為母親提供最好的醫療照護。

examples.en: Night markets offer a vast selection of affordable delicious food.
examples.zh: 夜市提供了多樣價格親民實惠的美味小吃。

examples.en: The city needs more affordable housing options for young working families.
examples.zh: 這座城市需要為年輕上班族家庭提供更多可負擔的合宜住宅。

examples.en: Taking the express train is both fast and remarkably affordable.
examples.zh: 搭乘特快車既快捷又相當經濟實惠。

examples.en: Imported luxury brand bags are usually very expensive.
examples.zh: 進口精品名牌包通常非常昂貴。

examples.en: Dining out every evening can become quite expensive over time.
examples.zh: 每天晚上都在外用餐時間久了會變得相當花錢。

examples.en: Making a hasty investment decision proved to be an expensive mistake.
examples.zh: 倉促做出投資決策事後被證明是一個代價高昂的錯誤。

examples.en: How much does this box of pineapple cakes cost?
examples.zh: 這盒鳳梨酥要花費多少錢？

examples.en: The total cost of repairing the damaged car was over two thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 修理受損車輛的總成本超過了兩千美元。

examples.en: The delay cost the firm both valuable time and client trust.
examples.zh: 這次延誤使該事務所損失了寶貴的時間與客戶的信任。

examples.en: As a college student, I cannot afford a luxury sports car.
examples.zh: 身為大學生，我買不起奢華的超級跑車。

examples.en: We can easily afford a weekend road trip to Kenting.
examples.zh: 我們完全負擔得起去墾丁度過週末公路之旅。

examples.en: With exam week approaching, we cannot afford to waste any study time.
examples.zh: 隨著考試週逼近，我們承擔不起浪費任何讀書時間。

examples.en: Insert two fifty-dollar coins into the capsule toy machine.
examples.zh: 在扭蛋機投入兩枚五十元硬幣。

examples.en: Let's flip a coin to decide who washes the dishes tonight.
examples.zh: 我們擲硬幣來決定今晚誰負責洗碗吧。

examples.en: Shakespeare coined many English expressions that are still used today.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞創造了許多至今仍被廣泛使用的英語詞彙表現方式。

examples.en: The New Taiwan Dollar thousand-dollar banknote features the Mikado pheasant.
examples.zh: 新台幣千元大鈔上印有帝雉圖案。

examples.en: Modern banknotes incorporate watermarks and holographic foils to deter counterfeiting.
examples.zh: 現代鈔票結合了水印與雷射全息箔膜以防偽造。

examples.en: He carefully flattened the crumpled banknotes inside his billfold.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地把皮夾裡皺巴巴的紙鈔撫平。

examples.en: Keep your ID cards and cash securely inside your pocket wallet.
examples.zh: 將證件與現金安全放在口袋皮夾裡。

examples.en: I realized with panic that I had left my leather wallet in the taxi.
examples.zh: 我驚慌地意識到自己把真皮皮夾忘在計程車上了。

examples.en: His wallet was stolen by a pickpocket while waiting in the crowded subway station.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的捷運站等車時，他的皮夾被扒手扒走了。

examples.en: She carried a small pink leather purse to the party.
examples.zh: 她提著一個粉紅色小皮包去參加聚會。

examples.en: The woman opened her purse to search for her house keys.
examples.zh: 女士打開手提包尋找她家裡的鑰匙。

examples.en: The golf tournament offers a multimillion-dollar winner's prize purse.
examples.zh: 這場高爾夫錦標賽提供高達數百萬美元的冠軍獎金總額。

examples.en: Chunghwa Post is Taiwan's official postal and banking service provider.
examples.zh: 中華郵政是台灣官方的郵政與儲匯服務機構。

examples.en: I need to stop by the post office to mail an international parcel.
examples.zh: 我需要順道去一趟郵局寄一件跨國包裹。

examples.en: The historical red-brick post office is located near the old train station.
examples.zh: 這座歷史悠久的紅磚郵局坐落在老火車站附近。

examples.en: Did we receive any snail mail or registered letters today?
examples.zh: 我們今天有收到任何實體信件或掛號信嗎？

examples.en: Please check your junk mail folder if you haven't received our confirmation email.
examples.zh: 如果您尚未收到確認信，請檢查您的垃圾郵件匣。

examples.en: I will mail this birthday present to my sister in Melbourne tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天會把這份生日禮物郵寄給我人在墨爾本的妹妹。

examples.en: Drop green airmail postcards into the red and green postbox.
examples.zh: 將綠色航空明信片投進紅白或綠色的郵筒中。

examples.en: There was a stack of advertising flyers stuffed inside my apartment mailbox.
examples.zh: 我公寓的信箱裡塞了一大疊廣告傳單。

examples.en: Check your electronic mailbox regularly for university notifications.
examples.zh: 定期檢查你的電子郵件信箱以接收大學各項通知。

examples.en: Stick a five-dollar stamp on the top-right corner of the postcard.
examples.zh: 在明信片右上角貼上一張五元郵票。

examples.en: He collects vintage commemorative stamps from countries all over the world.
examples.zh: 他蒐集來自世界各國具有紀念價值的骨董紀念郵票。

examples.en: The border officer stamped my passport at the airport checkpoint.
examples.zh: 邊境審查官員在機場查驗關卡上為我的護照蓋上了印章。

examples.en: Seal the red envelope carefully before giving New Year blessings.
examples.zh: 在送出新年祝福前把紅包袋仔細封好。

examples.en: Write the mailing address clearly on the front of the white envelope.
examples.zh: 在白色信封正面將郵寄地址書寫清晰。

examples.en: Open the letter opener carefully to avoid tearing the envelope contents.
examples.zh: 小心使用拆信刀，避免劃破信封內的信件內容。

examples.en: She wrote a heartfelt thank-you letter to her English teacher.
examples.zh: 她寫了一封真摯的感謝信給她的英文老師。

examples.en: There are twenty-six letters in the modern English alphabet.
examples.zh: 現代英文字母表一共有二十六個字母。

examples.en: Follow the instructions to the letter to achieve the best results.
examples.zh: 嚴格絲毫不差地遵循指示說明，以獲得最佳成果。

examples.en: I sent a scenic Jiufen postcard to my pen pal in Canada.
examples.zh: 我寄了一張九份風景明信片給我加拿大的筆友。

examples.en: Postcards depicting scenic Sun Moon Lake are popular with tourists.
examples.zh: 描繪日月潭美景的明信片深受觀光客喜愛。

examples.en: She displays colorful postcards from her global travels on the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 她將環遊世界各地旅行帶回的彩色明信片貼在冰箱上展示。

examples.en: The postman delivered a heavy online shopping package.
examples.zh: 郵差送來了一個沉甸甸的網購包裹。

examples.en: The hotel offers a weekend spa package including dinner and massage.
examples.zh: 飯店推出了包含晚餐與按摩的週末水療套裝行程。

examples.en: Handle this delicate glass package with extra care.
examples.zh: 搬運這件易碎玻璃包裹時要格外小心。

examples.en: Pick up your e-commerce parcels anytime at the smart parcel locker.
examples.zh: 隨時都能在智慧包裹櫃／智取店領取您的網購包裹。

examples.en: Enter your pickup SMS code on the screen to unlock the parcel locker.
examples.zh: 在螢幕上輸入簡訊取件碼即可解鎖包裹置物格。

examples.en: Smart parcel lockers provide secure twenty-four-hour delivery pickup for residents.
examples.zh: 智慧包裹取件櫃為居民提供全天二十四小時安全的收件服務。

examples.en: Food delivery riders deliver hot meals directly to your doorstep.
examples.zh: 美食外送員將熱騰騰的餐點直接送到你家門口。

examples.en: The president delivered an inspiring speech to university graduates.
examples.zh: 校長對大學畢業生發表了一場鼓舞人心的動人演說。

examples.en: The company promised to deliver high-quality software on schedule.
examples.zh: 該公司承諾會如期交付高品質的軟體產品。

examples.en: Foodpanda and Uber Eats offer speedy food delivery services.
examples.zh: Foodpanda 與 Uber Eats 提供迅速的美食外送服務。

examples.en: Expect free home delivery on all purchases over one thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 凡購物滿一千元即可享有免費宅配到府服務。

examples.en: The mother had a smooth and safe delivery at the regional hospital.
examples.zh: 這位母親在地區醫院順利平安分娩生下小寶寶。

examples.en: Choose express delivery if you want next-day arrival.
examples.zh: 如果您想要隔日送達，請選擇快捷宅配服務。

examples.en: We paid extra for express delivery so the flowers would arrive on Mom's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們額外支付了快遞費用，好讓鮮花能在媽媽生日當天送達。

examples.en: Express delivery options are available during checkout for urgent orders.
examples.zh: 結帳時可針對緊急訂單選用快捷快遞配送選項。

examples.en: Enter the 10-digit tracking number on the courier website.
examples.zh: 在快遞網站上輸入十位數的包裹追蹤號碼。

examples.en: You will receive an SMS containing your parcel tracking number once it ships.
examples.zh: 一旦包裹出貨，您將會收到一則包含包裹追蹤號碼的簡訊。

examples.en: Keep your tracking number handy when inquiring about package delivery status.
examples.zh: 查詢包裹遞送動態時，請隨手備妥您的追蹤號碼。

examples.en: You can track your package's real-time shipment progress online.
examples.zh: 您可以在線上追蹤包裹的即時運送進度。

examples.en: Athletes trained hard on the running track before the championship.
examples.zh: 運動員在冠軍錦標賽前在田徑跑道上刻苦訓練。

examples.en: The hunter followed the deer's fresh tracks in the soft mud.
examples.zh: 獵人跟隨軟泥中鹿群留下的新鮮足跡前進。

examples.en: The dedicated postman rides a green scooter across the town.
examples.zh: 敬業的郵差騎著綠色機車穿梭全鎮送信。

examples.en: Our friendly neighborhood postman always greets us with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 我們社區親切的郵差總是帶著溫暖的微笑向我們打招呼。

examples.en: The postman blew his whistle before delivering the registered parcel.
examples.zh: 郵差在遞送掛號包裹前按響了喇叭。

examples.en: Write the recipient's shipping address clearly in English.
examples.zh: 用英文將收件人的收件地址書寫清楚。

examples.en: The mayor delivered a powerful keynote address at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 市長在開幕典禮上發表了震撼有力的專題致詞演說。

examples.en: We need to work together to address environmental pollution issues.
examples.zh: 我們需要齊心協力來應對並解決環境污染問題。

examples.en: Fill in the 3+3 digit postal code for faster mail sorting.
examples.zh: 填寫 3+3 碼郵遞區號有助於郵件更快速分揀。

examples.en: Always double check that the postal code matches the city district.
examples.zh: 請務必再次確認郵遞區號與所在行政區相符。

examples.en: Automated sorting machines read postal codes to speed up mail delivery.
examples.zh: 自動分揀機會讀取郵遞區號以加快信件配送速度。

examples.en: Online shopping platforms often host double 11 shopping festivals.
examples.zh: 線上網購平台經常舉辦雙十一購物節活動。

examples.en: The convenience of online shopping allows consumers to buy goods 24/7.
examples.zh: 網路購物的便利性讓消費者能夠全天候隨時買東西。

examples.en: Online shopping has grown tremendously among elderly consumers in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來年長消費者群體中的網路購物比例大幅增長。

examples.en: Orders over $500 are eligible for waived shipping fees.
examples.zh: 訂單滿五百元即可享有免運費優惠。

examples.en: International shipping fees can sometimes exceed the cost of the actual item.
examples.zh: 跨國國際運費有時甚至可能超過商品本身的價格。

examples.en: The shipping fee will be calculated automatically based on package weight.
examples.zh: 運費將根據包裹重量在結帳時自動計算。

examples.en: Get free shipping on your first order this month!
examples.zh: 本月首次下單即可享有免運費好康！

examples.en: Many e-commerce stores offer free shipping when you purchase two items or more.
examples.zh: 許多電商店家在購買兩件或以上商品時提供免運費優惠。

examples.en: Enter the promotional coupon code to unlock free shipping on all books.
examples.zh: 輸入促銷折價代碼即可享有所有書籍免運費優待。
